notes.source: The plan card's words, in both clients. `npm run copy:generate` writes the two files named above from this one; neither client may spell these strings itself. Arabic writes a word's marks in more than one order and the two compare unequal while rendering the same, so a retyped label is a label that fails an exact-text test later (ADR-0098).
notes.placeholders: A string may carry `{name}` where a value is interpolated. Each client substitutes it itself rather than formatting around the sentence, so the punctuation stays in one place.
notes.gate: `npm run check:copy` fails a stale generated output, and `npm run check:parity` fails a copy key the reference component (`frontend/ui/account/plan-view.tsx`) does not render - the site is the design the app is measured against.
